title: discovery_run
description: One press of Go in the Discovery station: what was asked, which model and prices were used, what it cost, what came back and every record it created (see DISCOVERY_GUIDE.md and DISCOVERY_RUN_GUIDE.md). THE RUN RECORD IS HISTORY: it is never removed. Withdrawing a run soft-deletes the records it created and marks the run withdrawn. Only the Discovery service writes runs; the Console never creates or edits one directly. Rules the schema cannot express: actual_cost_cents is not above spend_cap_cents; estimated_cost_low_cents is not above estimated_cost_high_cents; max_results and spend_cap_cents are not above the maximums in the settings; steps_done is not above steps_planned; at most 40 steps; every area, type, model and prompt named must have existed and been active when the run started; a run is withdrawn only for records still inactive and untouched; fields marked readOnly are set by the server only.
x_retention: Kept forever. The run record is history and is never removed. (A written policy only.)

finder_key.description: Which finder ran, such as venue. Required.

status.description: planned (made, nothing sent yet), running, finished (all steps done), stopped (ended early; see stop_reason), failed (a problem ended it) or withdrawn (its candidates were taken back). Required.

stop_reason.description: Why a stopped run stopped: cap_reached (the spend cap), results_limit, operator (someone pressed Stop), mode_off (the mode was switched off) or too_many_no_answers. Required when status is stopped.

run_mode.description: dry_run (the prompts were built and the cost estimated; nothing was sent) or live (the AI was called). The mode in force when the run started. Required.

model_name.description: The model's name as it was when the run started. Up to 100 characters. Required.

model_price_input_per_million_cents.description: The input price per million tokens, in whole cents, that this run used. Required.

model_price_output_per_million_cents.description: The output price per million tokens, in whole cents, that this run used. Required.

model_price_search_per_1000_cents.description: The search price per 1,000 searches, in whole cents, that this run used. Optional.

area_ids.description: The states or regions searched (discovery_area ids), at least one, up to 50. Required.

area_labels.description: The names of those areas as they were at the time, so the history stays readable if they are renamed. Up to 50, each up to 120 characters. Optional.

type_keys.description: The types searched (discovery_type keys), at least one, up to 30. Required.

prompt_id.description: The published discovery_prompt record used. Required.

max_results.description: The most candidates this run was allowed to return. Required.

spend_cap_cents.description: The hard spend cap for this run, in whole US cents. Required.

estimated_cost_low_cents.description: The low end of the estimate shown before Go, in whole cents. Required.

estimated_cost_high_cents.description: The high end of the estimate shown before Go, in whole cents. Required.

actual_cost_cents.description: What the run has cost so far, in whole cents, rounded up. Steps with no answer are not counted here; see no_answer steps. Required.

input_tokens.description: Total input tokens the provider reported. Optional.

output_tokens.description: Total output tokens the provider reported. Optional.

search_count.description: Total web searches the provider reported. Optional.

steps_planned.description: How many steps the run was split into. Optional.

steps_done.description: How many steps have finished. Optional.

steps.description: One entry per step, in order, up to 40. Optional.

step_number.description: The step's position in the run, starting at 1. Required.

type_key.description: The type searched in this step. Required.

area_id.description: The state or region searched in this step. Optional.

status.description: ok (answered and read), no_answer (no reply in time; the cost is unknown), rejected (the provider refused it), skipped (not run, for example the cap was reached). Required.

result_count.description: How many candidates the answer held. Optional.

input_tokens.description: Input tokens the provider reported for this step. Optional.

output_tokens.description: Output tokens the provider reported for this step. Optional.

cost_cents.description: What this step cost, in whole US cents, rounded up. Optional; absent when the cost is unknown.

error_code.description: A short sanitized code when the step failed. Never provider text. Optional.

prompt_text.description: The exact text sent in this step, so the operator can always see what went to the AI. Up to 8,000 characters. Optional.

found_count.description: How many candidates the AI returned in total. Optional.

created_count.description: How many candidates were saved as new records. Optional.

duplicate_count.description: How many candidates were skipped as duplicates of records that already exist. Optional.

rejected_count.description: How many candidates were rejected as invalid. Optional.

attention_count.description: How many saved candidates were flagged as needing attention. Optional.

rejections.description: What was rejected and why, up to 100. Names and codes only. Optional.

name.description: The name of the thing that was rejected, as the AI gave it. Up to 200 characters. Optional.

reason.description: A short snake_case code, such as missing_needed_field, invalid_field or residential. Required.

fields.description: Field names involved, up to 20. Names only, never values. Optional.

created_organization_ids.description: Organizations this run created, so Withdraw can take them back. Up to 1,000. Optional.

created_location_ids.description: Places this run created. Up to 1,000. Optional.

created_venue_ids.description: Venues this run created. Up to 1,000. Optional.

created_organization_link_ids.description: Organization links this run created. Up to 1,000. Optional.

created_location_link_ids.description: Place links this run created. Up to 1,000. Optional.

finished_at.description: When the run finished, stopped or failed (UTC). Required once the status is finished, stopped or failed.

withdrawn_at.description: When the run was withdrawn (UTC). Required when the status is withdrawn.

withdrawn_by.description: Who withdrew it, as an actor string. Required when the status is withdrawn.

notes.description: A note from the operator, free text up to 2000 characters. Optional.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the record was created (UTC). Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who created it, as an actor string. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the record last changed (UTC). Set by the server.

updated_by.description: Who last changed it. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: dashboard or import. Set by the server.

deleted_at.description: When the record was soft deleted (UTC); absent while live. Set by the server.

deleted_by.description: Who soft deleted it. Set by the server.
